decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric sits close to the core offer, has its own page and costs little to carry, so after two seasons the option is still worth holding while demand evidence builds.
The bouclé-effect sheer has had only a brief mention online, which suggests weak traction, but production-partner sourcing keeps carrying costs low enough to wait one more season before deciding.
The double-face wool blend fits the shift toward renewable materials, which preserves its strategic option value even though its visibility is limited and its sales prospects are still uncertain.
The wool bouclé leno matches the sustainability direction but overlaps with other sheers in a broad portfolio, so it stays for now but is a likely candidate for rotation if results remain unclear.
The braided-structure fabric launched only in 2024 and has its own page, so its value is still largely unresolved and keeping this young option open is cheap.
